title: Great Lakes Science Center

services.name: Tickets
services.desc: Great Lakes Science Center is open Monday - Wednesday, 10 a.m. to 5 p.m., Thursdays 10 a.m. to 8 p.m. and Friday - Sunday, 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. unless otherwise noted. Tickets can be purchased online or on-site at the Box Office. Please note that the Science Center, including the Steamship William G. Mather, will be closed for home Cleveland Browns games. Great Lakes Science Center, home of the NASA Glenn Visitor Center, makes science, technology, engineering and math (STEM) come alive through hundreds of hands-on exhibits, temporary exhibitions, daily science demonstrations, and more! services.desc: Connect to your inner trailblazer as you explore the wild beauty of the Buckeye State in Ohio: Wild at Heart. As you kayak, mountain bike, ice fish and even dogsled your way through Ohio’s stunning parks and waterways, discover a story of resilience and the deep connection between people and nature. Experience a story of epic comebacks, from the return of bald eagles and trumpeter swans to the revival of once-polluted rivers. And meet the everyday Ohioans restoring Ohio’s natural treasures, such as wildlife rehabilitators preparing orphaned bobcats for release back to the wild.
